subject: ist-f
title: IST.F.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-38 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'in the final analysis, all of these concepts do translate on the physical universe level — which is to say, our actual lives are related to what has happened from the distortion of true information.' (C)IST-F (the concept of isolated focus) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality): the question is what isolated-focus produces when crossed with social-reality — when distortion has made isolated-focus an isolated, controlled phenomenon. AFL (affinity alignment) branches from the main line and leads to CULT-INFO-DY (culture-information dynamics), then to POL-DYM (political dynamics) and on to POST (postulation). INFO-ALGN (information alignment) also branches from the main line and leads to IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics), which carries INTR (interpretation).
